title: Range Function Workout
instructions: Use the `range()` function in its various forms to achieve the desired counting sequences and calculations.
steps: Use `range()` to print the numbers 0 through 7 (inclusive).
Use `range(start, stop)` to print the numbers 10, 11, 12, 13.
Use `range(start, stop, step)` to calculate the sum of all numbers from 1 to 10 that are divisible by 3 (i.e., 3, 6, 9). Assign the final sum to `sum_of_multiples_of_three`.
Use a negative step in `range()` to print a countdown from 4 down to 1 (inclusive).
